sections.title: Information We Collect
sections.content: We collect information that you voluntarily provide while registering for our events, including your name, email address, phone number, and payment information.

sections.title: How We Use Your Information
sections.content: Your information is used to manage registrations, process payments, communicate event updates, verify tickets, and improve our services.

sections.title: Payment Information
sections.content: Payments are securely processed through Razorpay. We do not store your complete debit or credit card details on our servers.

sections.title: Data Sharing
sections.content: We do not sell your personal information. Information may only be shared with trusted service providers necessary for payment processing, ticketing, and legal compliance.

sections.title: Data Security
sections.content: We implement reasonable administrative and technical measures to safeguard your personal information against unauthorized access.

sections.title: Contact
sections.content: For privacy-related concerns, please contact us at {{supportEmail}}.
